environment.qa_backend: http://localhost:4001; started temporarily with local FRONTEND_URL/BACKEND_URL and email disabled, then stopped
environment.database: remote Supabase test project; status confirmed by owner; hostname redacted
environment.supabase: remote Supabase test project; status confirmed by owner; hostname redacted
environment.mercado_pago: test seller identity confirmed by authenticated GET /users/me; test_user tag and generated test nickname pattern present; raw response/account identifiers excluded
environment.browser: Playwright 1.64.1 with headless Chromium; screenshots under qa/artifacts/20261104-r4

scenarios.name: Homepage and local service health
scenarios.result: Frontend returned HTTP 200. Backend /api/health returned HTTP 200. Existing services were not restarted.

scenarios.name: Signup empty/step validation
scenarios.result: Empty step was blocked; synthetic valid CPF and CNPJ advanced through respondent, company, and ESG profile steps. Final form enabled submit.

scenarios.name: Synthetic signup submit
scenarios.result: POST /api/auth/register returned HTTP 500 after 4.4 s. Prisma reports public.email_outbox missing. Supabase Auth user creation was followed by a delete attempt. Subsequent login returned HTTP 401. No migration applied.

scenarios.name: Invalid login
scenarios.result: Synthetic non-existent credentials returned HTTP 401 from local backend in about 3 s end-to-end; UI showed an invalid-credentials message; no session.

scenarios.name: Login after signup attempt
scenarios.result: The signup failed before local persistence; subsequent login for the synthetic account returned HTTP 401. Successful login/session/logout scenarios were unavailable.

scenarios.name: Unauthenticated app checkout route
scenarios.result: POST /api/checkout/preference without token returned HTTP 401 in 80 ms; no application order was created.

scenarios.name: Mercado Pago test seller identity
scenarios.result: Authenticated GET /users/me returned HTTP 200. Response had a test_user tag and generated test nickname pattern. No account identifiers or raw response were saved.

scenarios.name: Provider sandbox preference creation
scenarios.result: Two provider-only synthetic preferences returned HTTP 201 using the verified test seller. Response included init_point and sandbox_init_point. Only the sandbox URL was opened; no notification_url was configured. No payment was submitted.

scenarios.name: Opening sandbox checkout
scenarios.result: Chromium navigated to https://sandbox.mercadopago.com.br/checkout/v1/redirect and received HTTP 403 with a provider error page. The address was verified as sandbox; no payment form was submitted.

scenarios.name: Application order creation and checkout return
scenarios.result: App order creation requires an authenticated account; signup failed. Direct visits to success/failure return routes redirected to the login modal. No purchase status transition or successful return was exercised.

scenarios.name: Webhook invalid signature
scenarios.result: Local webhook accepted an unrelated merchant_order event with an invalid synthetic x-signature and returned HTTP 200 ignored. Controller/service inspection shows no x-signature validation. No payment state changed.

scenarios.name: Webhook payment event missing id
scenarios.result: Local payment event without paymentId returned HTTP 400 in 5 ms before any provider lookup.

scenarios.name: Webhook payment state transitions
scenarios.result: No app order or payment exists and checkout could not load (HTTP 403); approved/rejected/pending webhook transitions were not sent.

bugs.title: Cadastro always fails when email_outbox table is absent
bugs.reproduction: Submit a valid synthetic registration to local backend; request returns 500. Backend log says public.email_outbox does not exist. Auth user is then deleted. See qa/artifacts/20261104-r4/registration-blocker.txt.

bugs.title: Webhook does not validate x-signature
bugs.reproduction: POST an unrelated event to local /api/webhooks/mercadopago with x-signature=invalid-test-signature; response is 200 received/ignored. Source path: backend/src/modules/webhooks/services/mercadopagoWebhookService.ts and controller.

bugs.title: Sandbox checkout address returns HTTP 403
bugs.reproduction: Open the sandbox_init_point returned by the test preference in Chromium; final host/path remain sandbox.mercadopago.com.br/checkout/v1/redirect and provider returns 403 page.

blocked_items: Successful account creation/login and all authenticated app purchase states are blocked by missing public.email_outbox table. No database migration was run.
Checkout Pro sandbox page responds 403. No card or payment was submitted.
No buyer test account was verified for this application; transaction and payment-state tests were therefore not performed.
Webhook signature invalidity is accepted for ignored events; no payment-changing webhook was tested.

synthetic_accounts.result: signup attempt failed; temporary Supabase Auth account delete was called; subsequent login returned 401; no password or personal identifiers stored

improvements.item: Apply and verify the existing additive email_outbox migration in the explicitly test Supabase environment before retesting signup; preserve the current rule that migration application needs explicit authorization.
Validate Mercado Pago x-signature and request-id before processing any webhook; add local tests for missing/invalid/valid signatures and replay behavior.
Investigate the provider 403 for the verified sandbox_init_point and test seller preference; retain the provider domain/path and sanitized response evidence.

next_actions: After migration authorization/application, retry synthetic signup, successful login/logout, authenticated checkout and local return states.
Resolve sandbox checkout HTTP 403 with Mercado Pago support/configuration or a documented provider-side setting, then verify buyer test account before any payment submission.
Retest signature verification against localhost only after implementation; do not use the public ngrok notification URL in test preferences.
Revisit pending/approved/rejected app order transitions and local webhook fixtures once signup and test checkout are available.
